title: ADA Violation — Mandatory Biometric Collection Without Accommodation
holding: Mandatory iris scan enrollment as a condition of employment, without providing reasonable accommodation for employees with religious objections or disabilities, violates the ADA (42 U.S.C. § 12112) and Title VII. Employer must provide a reasonable alternative verification method.
text: Charging party's employer required all employees to enroll in a biometric iris scan system for time and attendance tracking. Charging party, who has a medical condition affecting iris appearance, requested an alternative method of identification. The employer denied the request without engaging in the interactive process required by the ADA. The Commission finds the employer's failure to provide a reasonable accommodation constitutes a violation of 42 U.S.C. § 12112(b)(5).
